title: RotterdamHaz: A Hazmat Road Transport Risk Benchmark for the Rotterdam–Rijnmond Port and Industrial Area

creators.name: Liu, Qiang
creators.affiliation: Academy of Artificial Intelligence, Beijing Institute of Petrochemical Technology

description:
RotterdamHaz is an open benchmark for hazmat road transport risk in the Rotterdam–Rijnmond port and industrial area, the Netherlands, built from Dutch and European official and open sources: a directed OSM road network (35,843 nodes, 80,277 arcs) with ADR tunnel categories, Basisnet sections and the A24 toll, per-arc release frequencies (BRON, CBS, RBM II), CBS 100 m population rasters, arc-to-cell impact sets for four substances, gravity-model OD demand calibrated and cross-validated against Rijkswaterstaat VGS dangerous-goods counts, problem instances, baselines, QA and build code.

Licences: database ODbL 1.0; rasters, parameters and documentation CC BY 4.0; code MIT (see LICENSES.md). Facilities are pseudonymised. Results are methodological, not a safety assessment.

Contact: liuq@bipt.edu.cn.
